entry.text: Project duration: 05/01/2018 – 18/06/2019
2. RX (Repair Expert) (Lumen)
Client Description: RX is a repair expert tool which helps agent to
troubleshoot the issues through multiple channel IVR, SSC and CSC. It
helps to resolve the issues regarding networking devices and also create
dispatch for the customer. It helps to get an idea about the outage in
central office.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Design the overall architecture of microservices.
• Develop RESTful microservices using Spring Boot.
• Implement service discovery using Eureka for service registration and
discovery.
• Configure Zuul as an API gateway for routing requests to appropriate
services.
• Implement client-side load balancing with Ribbon.
• Integrate Hystrix for fault tolerance and circuit breaking.
• Implemented OAuth2 and JWT for secure user authentication and
authorization.
•  Ensure proper database interactions with Oracle using JPA/Hibernate.
• Implement business logic and application services.
• Wrote unit testing for backend using Junit and Mockito.
• Create responsive UI using Angular components, directives, and
templates.
• Consume RESTful APIs using HttpClientModule.
• Use RxJS for reactive programming.
• Implement component-level and service-level state management.
• Optimize app performance (lazy loading, AOT compilation, etc.).
• Debug and fix issues across different browsers and devices.
Technology: Microservices using Spring Boot cloud, Netflix OSS (Zuul,
Eureka, Ribbon, Hystrix), Multithreading, Oracle, Angular 4.
